mapper.sql: json_build_object( 'reinspect_id', r.reinspect_id, 'total_id', r.total_id, 'work_id', r.work_id, 'status', r.status, 'reason', r.reason, 'request_user', r.request_user, 'request_date', to_char(r.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'confirm_user', r.confirm_user, 'confirm_date', to_char(r.confirm_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'confirm_note', r.confirm_note, 'update_at', to_char(r.update_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(repair_required_yn, 'N') FROM qfield.facility_total_view WHERE total_id = #{totalId} AND use_yn = 'y' LIMIT 1

SELECT json_build_object( 'items', COALESCE(json_agg( ORDER BY r.reinspect_id DESC), '[]'::json) )::text FROM map.facility_reinspection r
JOIN qfield.facility_total_view f ON f.total_id = r.total_id AND f.use_yn = 'y' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT emd_cd FROM public.g_emd e WHERE ST_Intersects(e.geom, ST_Transform(f.geom, 4326)) LIMIT 1 ) e ON true
WHERE r.status = 'REQUESTED' AND r.use_yn = 'y'
AND e.emd_cd LIKE #{code} || '%'

SELECT json_build_object( 'totalId', #{totalId}, 'items', COALESCE(json_agg( ORDER BY r.reinspect_id DESC), '[]'::json) )::text FROM map.facility_reinspection r WHERE r.total_id = #{totalId} AND r.use_yn = 'y'
SELECT r.reinspect_id FROM map.facility_reinspection r WHERE r.total_id = #{totalId} AND r.status = 'REQUESTED' AND r.use_yn = 'y' LIMIT 1

WITH r AS ( INSERT INTO map.facility_reinspection ( total_id, work_id, status, reason, request_user ) VALUES ( #{totalId}, #{item.work_id, jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'REQUESTED', #{item.reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.request_user, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) RETURNING * ) SELECT ::text FROM r

WITH r AS ( UPDATE map.facility_reinspection SET status = #{item.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reason = COALESCE(#{item.reason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reason), confirm_user = CASE WHEN #{item.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'REQUESTED' THEN NULL ELSE #{item.confirm_user, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END, confirm_note = CASE WHEN #{item.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'REQUESTED' THEN NULL ELSE #{item.confirm_note, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END, confirm_date = CASE WHEN #{item.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'CONFIRMED' THEN COALESCE(confirm_date, now()) WHEN #{item.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = 'REQUESTED' THEN NULL ELSE confirm_date END, update_at = now() WHERE reinspect_id = #{reinspectId} AND use_yn = 'y' RETURNING * ) SELECT ::text FROM r
mapper.update: UPDATE map.facility_reinspection SET use_yn = 'n', update_at = now() WHERE reinspect_id = #{reinspectId} AND use_yn = 'y'
